briefdescription.para: Generates a regular (regular) binary tree of a specified depth.

detaileddescription.para: A regular binary tree is a tree where all internal vertices have exactly two children and all leaf vertices are at the same depth. For a given depth $d$, the graph will contain exactly $2^d - 1$ vertices.
If the requested GraphType is directed, edges are created pointing from the parent vertex to its children.

blockquote.para: If the requested GraphType satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target graph type to generate.
The depth (number of levels) of the binary tree. A depth of 1 yields a single root vertex.

simplesect.para: A newly constructed graph representing the regular binary tree.

briefdescription.para: Generates a regular binary tree with bidirectional edges.

detaileddescription.para: For directed graphs, this function ensures that for every parent-to-child edge, a reciprocal child-to-parent edge is also created.
For undirected graphs, this function simply falls back to regular_binary_tree, as undirected edges are inherently bidirectional.

blockquote.para: If the requested GraphType satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target graph type to generate.
The depth of the binary tree.

simplesect.para: A newly constructed graph representing the bidirectional binary tree.

detaileddescription.para: A complete bipartite graph is a graph whose vertices are partitioned into two disjoint sets, $A$ and $B$, such that every vertex in $A$ connects to every vertex in $B$.
If the requested GraphType is directed, this function generates reciprocal edges (from $A$ to $B$ and from $B$ to $A$) to mimic full undirected connectivity.

blockquote.para: If the requested GraphType satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target graph type to generate.
The number of vertices in partition $A$.
The number of vertices in partition $B$.

simplesect.para: A newly constructed graph representing the biclique.

detaileddescription.para: A complete graph is a simple graph in which every pair of distinct vertices is connected by an edge.
If the requested GraphType is directed, this function generates fully bidirectional edges between every pair of vertices.

blockquote.para: If the requested GraphType satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. briefdescription.para: Generates a regular cycle graph (ring topology).

detaileddescription.para: A cycle graph consists of a single closed chain of vertices. Vertex $v_i$ is connected to vertex $v_{i+1}$, with the final vertex connecting back to vertex $v_0$.
For directed graphs, this creates a unidirectional loop.

blockquote.para: If the requested GraphType satisfies c_flat_list_graph, an optimized overload is automatically selected. It internally constructs a standard adjacency list graph first, and then utilizes the to conversion to flatten it. This is significantly faster than inserting edges one-by-one into a flat representation.

parameterdescription.para: The target graph type to generate.
The total number of vertices in the cycle.

simplesect.para: A newly constructed graph representing the cycle.

briefdescription.para: Generates a cycle graph with bidirectional edges.

detaileddescription.para: For directed graphs, this function creates a reciprocal edge for every forward edge in the closed chain, forming a bidirectional ring.
For undirected graphs, this function simply falls back to cycle, as undirected edges are inherently bidirectional.

briefdescription.para: Generates a regular path graph (linear topology).

detaileddescription.para: A path graph consists of a simple linear sequence of vertices. Vertex $v_i$ is connected to vertex $v_{i+1}$, terminating at the final vertex.
For directed graphs, this creates a one-way chain from the first to the last vertex.

briefdescription.para: Generators and evaluators for standard structural graph topologies.

detaileddescription.para: A collection of lightweight utilities designed to quickly instantiate classic graph topologies. Featuring out-of-the-box support for cliques (complete graphs), bipartite graphs, binary trees, paths, and cycles, these generators are ideal for rapid prototyping, algorithm benchmarking, and automated testing.
